description.value: Value Village is a large for-profit thrift store and donation centre in Langley, part of the Savers family of secondhand retailers. The store carries tens of thousands of gently used items including clothing, housewares, books, electronics, and sporting goods donated by the community. Its local nonprofit partner is Diabetes Canada, which receives payment for donated goods.
